mapper.select: select folder_num, team_num, folder_name, parent_folder_num, is_chat_folder, create_date, level as folder_level, connect_by_isleaf as is_leaf, sys_connect_by_path(folder_name,'/') as folder_path from file_folder where team_num = #{team_num} start with parent_folder_num is null connect by prior folder_num = parent_folder_num order siblings by create_date asc

select f.file_num, f.folder_num, f.channel_num, f.team_num, f.origin_name, f.save_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, f.file_type, f.file_source, f.upload_date, u.user_name as uploaderName, c.channel_name from chat_file f join users u on f.uploader_num = u.user_num left join chat_channel c on f.channel_num = c.channel_num where f.folder_num = #{folder_num} order by f.upload_date desc

select f.file_num, f.folder_num, f.channel_num, f.team_num, f.origin_name, f.save_name, f.file_path, f.file_size, f.file_type, f.file_source, f.upload_date, u.user_name as uploaderName, c.channel_name from chat_file f join users u on f.uploader_num = u.user_num left join chat_channel c on f.channel_num = c.channel_num where f.team_num = #{team_num} order by f.upload_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into chat_file( file_num,folder_num,team_num,uploader_num, origin_name,save_name,file_path, file_size,file_type,file_source, channel_num,upload_date ) values ( seq_chat_file.nextval, #{folder_num, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{team_num}, #{uploader_num}, #{origin_name}, #{save_name}, #{file_path}, #{file_size}, #{file_type}, #{file_source}, #{channel_num, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE )
